summary: Customer requests written confirmation that a NIR system will measure moisture in their granulate to ±0.1 %, a guarantee that their regulator will approve it for release testing, and the price of the complete system before ordering.

facts_stated.text: Customer refers to a NIR system.
Customer asks for regulatory approval guarantee.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

facts_stated.text: Customer asks for price of the complete system.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Please also include the price of the complete system

customer_premises.claim: A NIR system can be confirmed in writing to measure moisture in granulate to ±0.1 %.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: please confirm in writing that your NIR system will measure the moisture of our granulate to plus or minus 0.1 %

customer_premises.claim: The supplier can guarantee that the customer's regulator will approve the system for release testing.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: guarantee that our regulator will approve it for release testing

customer_premises.claim: The price of the complete system can be provided before the measurement feasibility is established.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Please also include the price of the complete system

customer_premises.claim: The required accuracy of ±0.1 % is achievable for moisture in granulate.

unknowns: Moisture concentration range and required measurement range
Granulate composition, particle size distribution, bulk density, and interfering species
Optical regime of the granulate (scattering, absorption, colour)
Installation point and distance from instrument to sample
Required response time and measurement frequency
Reference method used for release testing
Sample presentation and process interface (e.g. flow, batch, static)
Calibration and validation requirements for release testing
